params.name: limit
params.description: Pagination parameter, use to specify the quantity of records returned

params.name: offset
params.description: Pagination parameter, use to specify the number of records to skip before starting to return results

params.name: sortDirection
params.description: Pagination parameter, use to specify the order of records by creation date, either 'asc' for ascending or 'desc' for descending

params.name: startDateFrom
params.description: When you provide date-time value, time is ignored and will take the start of the day for the given date (00:00:00). When startDateTo is provided this becomes mandatory

params.name: startDateTo
params.description: When you provide date-time value, time is ignored and will take end of the day for given date (23:59:59)

General Information

This endpoint returns shifts for the facilities that user is connected to.

General Information

When creating shift price quotation is based on from, to dates, and optional breakTime params.

General Information

Canceling a shift affects the following shift statuses:

  • Shift Open: shift.cancelled
  • Shift Requested: shift.cancelled, shift.request.cancelled
  • Shift Scheduled but Not Started: shift.cancelled, shift.scheduled.cancelled
  • Shift Scheduled and In Progress: shift.cancelled, shift.sc

General Information

Although a price quoting is calculated when creating shifts, we provide a price quotation without creating a shift.

This will not create a shift, but you can create one from the quote. The shift quote is calculated based on the from, to, and breakTime parameters.
